source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Cherem and Karet (ars-magica-realms#048); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Karet. condition. A severe religious sanction treated as spiritual death, with the condemned dead said to become spirits cut off from heaven. [verb transform; also needs spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Golem madness. condition. Certain crises trigger a stress roll that can permanently shift a golem’s trust, vengeance, or loyalty, while a botch causes madness. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Golem torpor. condition. A trusting golem placed to sleep by someone in its community neither ages nor needs bodily sustenance until awakened or an event occurs. [verb bind; also needs time-manipulation] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Karaite Magic restriction. condition. This restriction bars divination, astrology, and summoning or using spirits. [verb block; also needs familiar-summon] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Infernal aura. condition. A region of Infernal influence with strength from 1 to 10 that distorts surroundings and can affect people according to its intensity. [verb alter; also needs mind-state, formation-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Tarnished Auras (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Tarnished aura. condition. An aura strengthens one sinful Personality Trait for everyone inside by its strength, and matching indulgence yields a Warping Point and a Confidence Point. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Corrupted Auras (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Corrupted aura. condition. A permanently tarnished Infernal aura of strength at least 3 has additional features that encourage sin and cannot be retarnished by an Infernalist. [verb alter; also needs concept-law] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Debauched Auras (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Debauched aura. condition. This corrupted aura encourages self-indulgence and weakness, with possible effects such as preventing Confidence use, impeding escape, or making resistance costly. [verb bind; also needs mind-binding] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Malevolent Auras (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Malevolent aura. condition. This corrupted aura may increase damage and physical botch risk, deform or corrupt resident creatures, and revive old wounds caused by Infernal beings. [verb alter; also needs negative-effect-drift, body-code-decay] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Perfidious Auras (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Perfidious aura. condition. This corrupted aura makes lies harder to detect, grants Infernal beings temporary Confidence, and can stun those who fail Confidence-modified rolls after losing their Confidence. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Tartaran Regiones (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Tartaran regio. condition. This Infernal regio burns without fuel, prevents Fatigue recovery until departure, and inflicts hellfire damage that increases with the victim’s sinful traits. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Abyssal Regiones (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Abyssal regio. condition. This Infernal regio reduces all eight Characteristics by its strength and can cause temporary or permanent mental Flaws after failed daily Intelligence rolls. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Warping (ars-magica-realms#051); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal Warping. condition. Warping mainly caused by Infernal influence tends to produce flaws that encourage sin and make resisting immoral urges harder. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Demonic Weaknesses — Weaknesses (ars-magica-realms#053); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Compulsiveness. condition. A demon must count purposefully scattered objects in its sight before it can proceed. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Demonic Weaknesses — Weaknesses (ars-magica-realms#053); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ordering. condition. The demon cannot affect things that have been sealed, counted, measured, or tied up. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Demonic Weaknesses — Weaknesses (ars-magica-realms#053); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Protected Group. condition. The demon cannot use its powers against a specified group and can only defend itself if they attack. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Demonic Weaknesses — Weaknesses (ars-magica-realms#053); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Running Water. condition. The demon cannot cross fresh water flowing directly from the earth. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Demonic Weaknesses — Weaknesses (ars-magica-realms#053); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Vulnerability. condition. Touch by a specified substance wounds the demon, and weapons made of it add a Light Wound on a successful attack. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Furies — Powers (ars-magica-realms#054); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Endurance of the Enraged. condition. The Fury ignores wound penalties except when calculating Defense totals. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: A Life Lacking in Virtue (ars-magica-realms#054); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Confidence Point virtue simulation. condition. A demon spends a Confidence Point to imitate a virtue for the duration of the situation that calls for it. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 9: Infernal Characters — False Powers (ars-magica-realms#057); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: False Powers. condition. A power can seem aligned with Magic or Faerie while registering as unholy to Divine sensing. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Vituperation (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Vituperation. condition. Infernal power can overwhelm an infernalist after major Warping gain or failed control, causing a potentially prolonged ordeal followed by an Aging roll with modified Warping Score added. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Characters with Demonic Blood (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Demonic Blood. condition. A demon-blooded human is sterile and needs no food or drink, yet still experiences the urges of hunger, thirst, and reproduction. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Powers — Diablerie (ars-magica-realms#060); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal blessing. condition. A Forsaken supernatural grant that can persist until the recipient seeks redemption, but is lost on absolution and brings backlash when used for non-sinful ends. [verb add; also needs vow-cost] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Powers — Malediction (ars-magica-realms#060); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal curse. condition. A usually Forsaken affliction that persists until dispelled, commonly through Divine agency or another Infernal Power. [verb bind; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — False Magic (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
